properties.description: As built 2026-09-19. STATUS: every constructor of a type that carries a status takes an optional `status` and its description names what omitting it lands — add_component, add_release, add_project and add_epoch join add_capability, add_artifact, add_verification, add_requirement and add_decision (nine of nine; Question and Fragment are minted by ask/ingest, not by a constructor). The landing defaults STAY, because the detectors read them (closure.rs, detect.rs, heal.rs read `planned`; the certainty doctrine reads Requirement `proposed`) — what was missing was the parameter, which is the F10 row exactly: add_component wrote a status it offered no way to say. `approver` + `acted_at` stay on exactly the three constructors whose status is settled intent (Requirement, Decision, DesignRule — the three cases tools/check_intent_authority.py reads); a build status is a measurement, not a signature, and the test pins that set so a fourth cannot drift in unnoticed. NAMING: 25 tools whose primary parameter names a design node by a typed key (decision_id, capability_id, epoch_id, requirement_id, verification_id, interface_id, artifact_id, project_id, release_id, flow_id, constraint_id, change_event_id, subject_id, target_id) accept `id` and `node_id` as serde aliases — the key search_design hands back, or the name the last tool used — and the published schema still teaches the typed key only; `props` accepts `properties` on create_edge, create_node, create_edges and create_nodes. Tools whose key names a FINDING (gap_id, defect_id) are deliberately outside it. add_project has its own request shape (ProjectReq) instead of sharing add_interface's with half the fields ignored for the other. The adopt skill says to pass `status: realized` in the constructor call, since there is no component status setter. Tests: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/one_status_contract_across_sibling_constructors.rs, crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_node_is_named_by_the_key_the_last_tool_used.rs.
properties.name: One status contract across sibling constructors, and a node is named by the key the last tool used
